newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding up to 70,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding up to 70,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award up to 70,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender later on Wednesday, traders said.
A range of between 40,000 and 70,000 tonnes was forecast for this week's authorised tonnage after the EU awarded 31,000 tonnes in its last tender on December 4.
Traders estimated the maximum restitution for licences at 46.854 Ecus (European currency units) per 100 kg of sugar, based on the Paris March white sugar contract.
Last week's maximum restitution was 46.690 Ecus. Licences are currently valid until the end of May.
